excerpt: 应用于填充 3d 硅通孔 TSV 和 2.5D 转接板的三维电镀设备 Ultra ECP 3d。基于盛美半导体电镀设备的平台，该设备可为高深宽比（深宽比大于 10:1）铜应用提供高性能、无孔洞的镀铜功能。
scope_note: Supplier application/capability claim in FY2025 annual report; no inference of independent HBM qualification, TSV-only revenue or dated product launch. Aspect ratio >10:1 is a capability specification, not installed-base/adoption metric.
